picks.title: Binance sees $3.64 billion in net outflows after reopening withdrawals following record hack
picks.summary: The exchange said the outflows equal 2.1% of its $171 billion in assets and that withdrawal volumes have declined after an initial spike.

picks.title: Bitcoin ETF Investors Head for the Exits After Record Binance Hack
picks.summary: Bitcoin ETFs saw $643.2 million in outflows Friday, the first full trading session after the $6.4 billion Binance hack, ending October with roughly $516 million in net outflows.
